idea-plugin.name: PHP Autoload Mapping
idea-plugin.description:
PHP Autoload Mapping validates existing PHP declarations against deterministic class-to-file mappings that are not fully represented by PhpStorm's native inspection.

Choose a bundled convention or application schema for ZF1, Laravel 3, CodeIgniter 2, or PEAR/PSR-0; alternatively configure controlled declarative patterns with fixed literals, typed formats, independent alternatives, and explicit fallback chains.

The plugin works only with existing declarations in files PhpStorm recognizes as PHP. Global rules remain global; namespace mapping participates only when explicitly declared. When the native PSR path inspection overlaps, the plugin warns and offers an explicit, project-profile-only action to disable it; it never changes inspection settings automatically.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
261.1.0

  • Add structured canonical values, case formats, explicit separators, and controlled restrictions.
  • Expose pair validation and both derivation directions independently.
  • Evaluate all top-level candidates per recognized PHP file without selecting a class arbitrarily.
  • Add flat, explicitly ordered fallback chains and named alternative quick fixes.
  • Use a project-relative Base directory for every rule, without changing PhpStorm source folders.
  • Choose between the Project scheme and reusable Default/custom IDE schemes from a PhpStorm-style header.
  • Copy mappings explicitly between Project and IDE storage; rename or delete only custom IDE schemes.
  • Duplicate and share complete schemes through validated, versioned XML import/export.
  • Apply built-in rule packs from a visible Add from menu as batches of editable rules.
  • Cache compiled project mappings and validate class-to-file mappings without custom indexes.
